name: default
description: Standard in progress (commit as post) -> review -> PR flow

stages.name: in progress
stages.description: Agent implements the task, then commits as the stage's tail work

post.name: commit
post.prompt: Commit the relevant work for this task. Original task: $TASK_PROMPT

stages.name: review
stages.description: Review agent checks quality and test coverage before PR creation
stages.prompt: Review branch $BRANCH for task quality and test coverage against base $BASE_REF. Original task: $TASK_PROMPT.

stages.name: pr
stages.prompt: Create a PR for the work on branch $BRANCH.
